bitcoin_articles.headline: Galaxy Digital Transfers 1,900 BTC to New Wallets
bitcoin_articles.summary: Galaxy Digital moved 1,900 Bitcoin, valued at approximately $148 million, to nine newly created digital wallets.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Datavault AI Discloses Inaccessibility of Bitcoin Linked to $150 Million Scilex Deal
bitcoin_articles.summary: Datavault AI reported that Bitcoin assets associated with a $150 million transaction involving Scilex Holding Co are currently inaccessible, leading to a significant decline in Datavault's share price.
